captions.detailed: A modern personal blender consisting of a heavy, solid cylindrical motor base in matte black, and an inverted, semi-transparent tall blending cup resting on top. Inside the neck of the inverted cup, a metallic crossed-blade assembly is mounted on a central pin. The blade assembly is designed to rotate freely around its central vertical axis via a continuous revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a personal blender. It should feature a solid black cylindrical motor base, a translucent tall blending cup inverted onto the base, and a metallic crossed blade assembly inside the cup's base connected by a continuous revolute joint to simulate spinning.
captions.factory: The base is constructed using stacked cylinders to form the main motor housing and its collar. The blending cup is generated by lofting or revolving a profile to create its tapered, hollow cylindrical shape, which is then inverted and positioned atop the base. The blade assembly is built by intersecting or combining crossed rectangular boxes with angled faces to simulate blades, mounted on a small central cylinder. Finally, a continuous joint is defined along the Z-axis, connecting the blade assembly to the cup base.
